ruleset.name: foundry-no-var
ruleset.description: Disallow `var` (Java local type inference) unless explicitly justified.

rule.name: NoVar
rule.message: Avoid `var`; use an explicit type, or justify with a trailing `// foundry-allow-var: reason` comment.
rule.description: `var` hides the concrete type at the use site, which hurts readability for humans and agents alike. Prefer an explicit type. Where `var` is genuinely warranted (e.g. an unspeakable or very long generic type), keep it and add a trailing `// foundry-allow-var: <reason>` comment on the same line; the CI run uses that as PMD's suppress marker.
